newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police seek details on Chinese mafia.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police seek details on Chinese mafia.

text.p: Colombian officials hope to find out more about possible heroin trafficking links between the Chinese mafia and Colombian drug cartels during a current visit to Beijing, national police chief Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano said on Sunday.

In an interview with Colombian radio in the Chinese capital, Serrano said intelligence reports indicated Colombian drug barons and members of the Chinese criminal underworld were cutting heroin deals in Vancouver and later shipping the drug throughout North America.

But he ruled out any link between the two groups, saying that they were essentially in competition with one another given that, according to a report by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) last month, Colombia has edged out southeast Asia's Golden Triangle as the No.1 supplier of high-grade heroin to the United States.

Serrano, who is accompanying President Ernesto Samper and other government ministers on the trip, said: "We will be interested in finding out the ways in which the Chinese mafia operates but although the Colombia drug cartels have made contacts with the Russian and Italian mafias it does not seem that they have penetrated the Chinese mafia, which is the most closed in the world."
The September DEA report said 62 percent of all heroin confiscated in the United States came from Colombia.

Serrano said according to his information, the Chinese mafia moved the bulk of their cocaine shipments in through Vancouver with Chinese immigrants from Hong Kong, who are resettling before the British hand over the colony to the Chinese.

"The Colombian cartels and those from Asia are essentially in competition. But I have been told there is a presence of the Colombian cartels in Vancouver where they trade heroin and send it on to San Francisco and Toronto."
While in China, Colombian officials will be looking to promote Colombian exports -- mainly coffee and cut flowers -- to the Communist nation.
